modules.description: RFC 0016 K11: render_lab's presenting host, the lab's scenes on a real display through render.pass.output and render.presentation.v1 (the SDL3-Vulkan bridge over the render.backend.v1 provider on the Vulkan adapter's host device). The headless render_lab keeps linking no window system.

RFC 0026: the 3DS portal lab, a standalone program on render.device.pica that draws one portal scene with each portal technique (stencil, cropped stencil, screen texture, portal-plane textures with caching and recursion) over one camera path and measures CPU time, draws, indices and rasterized fragments; its geometry is checked on the host by portal_math_test.
RFC 0016 K11 device suites of render_lab's presenting host (render.lab.hdr), judged with the output oracle of render.core-tests.

RFC 0016 K11: render_lab, the render core composed alone (no engine, material system, legacy frontend or SDL), rendering scenes from BSP2 maps, studio models and VMT materials through the Vulkan adapter to prove each lighting term against Cycles.
RFC 0014: what the debug controls draw that no program draws (the not-applicable hatch over a target under a pixel view).

RFC 0016 layer 6 feature (RFC 0010 in-world panels): a UI panel placed in the world (Portal 2's chamber sign) drawn as a PBRMetalRough emissive surface, its image rasterized from the frame's draw list at the resolution of its footprint on screen, with a linear-light mip chain.

RFC 0016 layer 6 feature, K8 post cohort: the luminance counts behind the client's auto exposure (the legacy luminance_compare_ps2x occlusion-query histogram) as a compute count over a texture rectangle, read back once its frame completes.

RFC 0016 layer 6 feature, K8 sprites cohort: the client's pixel visibility proxies (glow sprites, coronas) drawn at their slot under occlusion queries (device clause D43), depth-tested and untested, read back once their frame completes.

RFC 0016 render.lighting.v1 indirect diffuse, the projected lights' share: their one bounce from reflective shadow maps, gathered into an atlas of the probe volume's layout that the surface program samples with the volume's weights.
RFC 0016 K12, render.lighting.v1 indirect diffuse: the indirect-light producers' GPU work (RFC 0011's SDF producer, render.gpu-compute.v1) on the core's device port.
RFC 0016 render.lighting.v1 'Ambient occlusion': ground-truth ambient occlusion (Jimenez et al. 2016) from the view's depth and normals, applied by the surface program to indirect light only.

RFC 0016 render.lighting.v1 'Screen-space reflections' (render.ssr.v1): glossy reflections traced in the current frame's lit colour through a hierarchical depth walk, blended over the image-based specular by hit confidence.

targetOwners.description: RFC 0001 'Waf target checks' migration sidecar. Every recorded Waf target declares its owner capability module with arch_module in its wscript (checked when the target is posted, and by archlint targets), or is listed in exactly one legacy group here: legacy code whose links no module bounds yet, counted but not judged. Each group names the roadmap row that retires it. New targets declare arch_module; groups only shrink.

A new shared library fails until it is linked statically or reviewed into a group; entries that no tree builds are stale.

layerContracts.description: RFC 0016 render core layers, checked by archlint CAP011. Dependencies point down: a module may depend only on modules in lower layers or on the external bases; features and renderers, and device adapters, are independent siblings; only render.composition and test fixtures name an adapter (fixtures sit in their own top layer, above composition); portable modules never compare the device's diagnostic backend identifier. The outside group lists render modules that predate the core; they retire with the legacy stream (R91, RFC 0016 K9) and shrink only.

outside.reason: Render modules from before the core (the native Vulkan backend inside shaderapivulkan, its bridges and tests, and the legacy provider glue). RFC 0016 moves them into the layered modules by phase (Appendix A.3) and deletes the rest at K9.

layerContracts.description: RFC 0027 product pipeline libraries. Profiles under contracts; providers (toolchains, recipe builders, stages, packagers, transports) are adapters of product.contracts that only kiln.composition, the fixture platform and tests name. kiln.core therefore never depends on a provider (rule 3), so adding a platform needs no core change.

RFC 0027 kiln: the pipeline API (kiln.core, public as kiln.api) over the product contracts, the default composition above it, and the thin application on top. The application may use only the API, the composition and JSON (rule 6); kiln.core names no platform, SDK or package form in a string (rule 7).

forbiddenLiterals.reason: kiln.core names no OS, SDK, package form, transport, build tool, pixel format or asset kind; it asks the provider the profile names (RFC 0027 "The rule")

legacyAbi.description: Preserved binary ABI declarations and exact private compatibility adapters/tests. Video provider runtime supplies the existing IVideoSubSystem::Connect factory without exposing it through the typed catalog. The Linux VBSP host tool keeps its material and physics factories in its private legacy compile-tool adapters. Reviewed 2026-09-25 (R04-DRIFT, user decision): the imported matchmaking framework's IAppSystem::Connect, the Portal 2 GameUI's IGameUI::Initialize/Connect, the Box3D provider's IPhysics::QueryInterface and the VPhysics conformance test host, which loads each provider through its CreateInterface export. Reviewed 2026-09-25 (static composition, agent decision under the user's standing instruction): public/engine/linked_game_modules.h binds a statically composed product's client, server and GameUI modules to the engine; the game module contract is the CreateInterface ABI. Reviewed 2026-09-26 (RFC 0016 K0, agent decision under the user's standing instruction): the frozen render surface of RFC 0016 'Compatibility surface' — the material system (IMaterialSystem 081 with IMatRenderContext, IMaterial, IMaterialVar, ITexture, IMesh, IMaterialProxy 003 and its factory, IMaterialSystemHardwareConfig 012), IStudioRender 025, IVRenderView 014, IVModelRender 016, IShadowMgr, and the mod shader ABI (ShaderDLL004, IShader, CBaseShader, CBaseVSShader, IShaderShadow 010, IShaderDynamicAPI, IShaderUtil, IShaderAPI, IShaderDevice, IShaderSystem); legacy.render-abi holds their vtable order.

loaderExceptions.description: RFC 0001 'Baseline and exceptions': reviewed exceptions to the ARCH101-ARCH105 loader ratchet. Each names one file, one rule and the exact number of unbaselined occurrences it covers, with a reason, an owning roadmap row, a tracking record and a removal condition. archlint fails on a count mismatch or a stale entry. Added 2026-09-25 by R04-DRIFT (user decision) for the Portal 2 reconstruction glue.
